title: The chat composer keeps the text an input method inserts right after its own Backspaces (Telex "toi" + "o" gives "tôi", not "t")
steps: S2: Read the fork package.json version.
S3: In vendor/tracy/deepseek-harness run vitest on packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/type-after-backspace.client.spec.ts.
expect: S1: registerTypeAfterBackspace(editor: LexicalEditor) is defined, register() installs it right after registerPlainText(this.editor), and an insertText whose target ranges include a non-collapsed one is left to Lexical.
S2: the version is -tracy.47 or later.
S3: 3 of 3 pass. On the old pin 6ae58956eb (tracy.46) the input-method case gives 't' instead of 'tôi'.
evidence: Local stand 13/10/2026, Chrome macOS via CDP: 'toi' + 2 Backspaces + insertText 'ôi' left 't' on tracy.46.
fence: The composer's handling of insertText after a handled Backspace: caret insertions are kept, range replacements stay suppressed.
